summary: Russia conducted a large-scale overnight drone strike on Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian oblasts, targeting a university in Kyiv during classes and causing casualties in Dnipro. Ukrainian air defenses and drone operations reportedly destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast. Russia claimed strikes on Ukrainian logistics infrastructure including a center in Korchevate and a dry cargo ship in the port of Chernomorsk.
key_points: Russian Shahed drones struck a university in Kyiv during classes; all 160 students were in shelter, according to Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/83846)
Russian attack on food warehouse of a retail chain in Dnipro killed 2 and wounded at least 6. (Source: @UkraineNow/83844)
Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeysk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 near Millerovo airfield in Rostov Oblast. (Source: @UkraineNow/83858)
Enemy drone hit near an Odessa-Dnipro train; passengers and crew were evacuated and the locomotive absorbed the impact. (Source: @UkraineNow/83856)
Russia claims to have struck a logistics center in Korchevate used for storing and distributing supplies for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. (Source: @tass_agency/393320)
Russia claims its forces struck a dry cargo ship carrying military equipment for the Armed Forces of Ukraine in the port of Chernomorsk. (Source: @tass_agency/393321)

Multiple waves of 10–16 reactive Shahed drones were tracked heading from Poltava and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts toward Kyiv oblast, with additional drones from Chernihiv oblast targeting Vyshhorod district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73316)
Russian MoD claims 238 Ukrainian drones were shot down over Russian regions during the day. (Source: @tass_agency/393346)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive overnight drone strike across Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Ternopil, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv. Russian Shahed drones struck a university in Kyiv during classes, though all 160 students were in shelter per Zelensky. Russian attacks also killed 2 and wounded at least 6 in Dnipro and hit near an Odessa-Dnipro train, while Ukrainian forces claimed downing a Russian Ka-27 and MiG-29 at rear airfields.

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo remains extremely high with Russian forces conducting a multi-axis saturation drone campaign spanning at least seven Ukrainian oblasts. The deliberate strike on a Kyiv university during class hours, combined with attacks on civilian food warehouses in Dnipro and passenger rail infrastructure, signals an escalation in strikes against dual-use and civilian targets. Ukrainian demonstrated ability to strike Russian rear aviation assets at Yeysk and Millerovo airfields indicates continued long-range drone capability development. The reported shootout between GUR and SBU officers in Kyiv's Berezniaky district introduces internal security concerns that could affect coordination during a high-tempo air campaign.
sections.regional_response: Germany announced new air defense packages will arrive in Ukraine this month per Zelensky, representing continued Western military support amid the escalation. US Secretary of State Rubio stated that even with a license, Ukraine will need several years to build Patriot production plants, highlighting long-term capability gaps despite immediate aid. Russia's Foreign Ministry promised a harsh response to anti-Russian German actions regarding the Leipzig incident, indicating potential diplomatic friction between Moscow and Berlin. The UN expressed concern about expansion of the Ukraine conflict due to Zelensky's threats regarding civil aviation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple indicators suggest Russia is employing layered, multi-directional drone tactics from Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv, Khmelnytskyi, and Crimea vectors simultaneously, complicating air defense allocation. The reported downed Ukrainian drone count of 238 over Russian regions in a single day is a notable figure that, if accurate, reflects either intensified Ukrainian drone operations or possible inflation in Russian reporting. The coordination of SBU and GUR on counter-terrorism operations juxtaposed with reports of a shooting incident between their officers suggests potential inter-agency friction that warrants monitoring. Claimed Russian liberation of Kazachya Lopan in Kharkov and clearing operations in Svyatogorsk DPR should be verified through independent confirmation.
